name: Manoah
bio:
Manoah was a Danite from Zorah, the father of Samson. His wife was childless, and the angel of the LORD appeared to her, announcing that she would conceive and bear a son set apart to God as a Nazirite from birth, whose hair must never be cut, and who would begin to deliver Israel from the Philistines (Judges 13:2-5).

After his wife told him what had happened, Manoah prayed that the man of God would appear again to teach them how to raise the child; the LORD granted this, and the angel appeared again to his wife (Judges 13:8-9). Manoah went in person to meet the man and asked his name, but the angel replied, "Why do you ask my name? It is beyond understanding." Manoah then offered a young goat and a grain offering on a rock, and as the flame rose up from the altar, the angel ascended in it; Manoah and his wife, terrified, fell face down on the ground, and Manoah, now realizing it had been the angel of the LORD, cried to his wife, "We are going to die! We have seen God!" His wife reassured him that if the LORD had meant to kill them, he would not have accepted their offering or revealed all these things to them (Judges 13:15-23).

His wife later bore a son and named him Samson, and the child grew, and the LORD blessed him (Judges 13:24). After Samson's death, his brothers and his father's whole family came and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of Manoah his father (Judges 16:31).
